feature_policy.notes: Customs trade data is monthly, so it is strongest as a medium-term supply pressure feature rather than an intraday or one-week signal.

cabbage.reason: 배추 rows exist, but the HS prefix also groups nearby brassica items such as cabbage variants. Filter by statKor before training.

radish.reason: Rows exist with large import volume, but the prefix includes several root vegetables. Use statKor filtering.

onion.reason: Large recent import volume and clear onion/shallot family mapping.

green_onion.reason: Rows exist, but leek and similar allium items can be mixed. Use statKor filtering.

garlic.reason: Clear garlic mapping and recent import rows.

potato.reason: High import volume and useful medium-term substitution pressure.

sweet_potato.reason: Clear sweet-potato mapping, though volume is smaller than onion/carrot/potato.

pepper.reason: Dried/crushed pepper rows exist. Keep separate from fresh pepper in the model.

fresh_pepper.reason: Fresh pepper rows exist, but bell pepper and other pepper categories can be mixed.

tomato.reason: Clear mapping, but recent import volume is near zero. Treat as low-pressure feature unless imports spike.

cucumber.reason: Mapping exists, but recent import volume is near zero. Useful mainly as a spike detector.

chamoe.reason: The HS prefix is a melon-family bucket. Do not train directly until exact statKor filtering is locked.

watermelon.reason: Rows exist but import weight is zero in the tested window. Use as no-import baseline.

carrot.reason: Very large import volume and strong substitution pressure candidate.

spinach.reason: Clear mapping with low but nonzero import volume.

lettuce.reason: Lettuce rows exist, but category split should be reviewed before training.

perilla.reason: The prefix is a broad other-vegetables bucket. Use only after exact item-name filtering.

sesame.reason: Large import volume and clear mapping.

apple.reason: Clear mapping but near-zero import volume; use as a weak feature or import-spike detector.

pear.reason: Rows exist but import weight is zero in the tested window.

grape.reason: Large seasonal import volume and clear mapping.

strawberry.reason: Clear mapping but near-zero recent import volume; use as a weak feature or import-spike detector.
